notes: Rebuilt design tokens for a GXP-like workbench (WS2). 'observed' = pixel-sampled from public BAE release-note screenshots (v4.5/4.6; scaled and compressed, so treat as +/- a few levels); 'estimated' = read by eye from screenshots or video frames; 'guess' = design choice where no evidence exists. Every value is [unverified] against a live SOCET GXP installation. Two palettes: 'colors' (observed GXP-grey look) and 'colorsDarkDerived' (derived dark theme for the workbench; all 'guess'). Sizes are given at 100% Windows scaling (CSS px). Do not copy GXP icons, logos or names into the tool. Source IDs refer to 02-ui-visual-language.md. GIS Workbench additions (2026-10-26): GW contextual captions, focus ring, banner colours and a print palette, all 'guess'. GIS Workbench 2.0 (2026-10-28): colorsM3Light and colorsM3Dark (Material 3 roles m3.* plus re-skins of the chrome tokens) and the shapes scale for the Modern layout (REQ-SHL-13); all 'guess'.

cursor3D.description: Surface-tracking 3-D cursor in 3D Multiport; Shift+wheel raises/lowers
